quest.title: Gliding Challenge: New Heights
quest.description: During the special welcome ceremony, Amber and her juniors have prepared a brand-new flying and shooting challenge, waiting for people to come and experience it...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Let me introduce our new colleague — this is Eija, Signals Officer for the 7th Company. And this is her able assistant, Vesper.

dialogues.speaker: Eija
dialogues.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance, Honorary Knight and the Helper in White. It's an honor to meet you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, this falcon is so well-behaved! It looks like it's wearing armor, and it's even carrying a tiny bag!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on a second, Paimon's confused... What did Amber mean when she said "performance"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does this have something to do with Miss Eija and Vesper?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Haha, let me explain.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Master Jean probably told you we're holding a wind glider speed shooting event, am I right? That's a very simple way of explaining it...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: In reality, it might be a little different from your expectations. This event is more like a "flying performance and instruction challenge."

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The crux of this event isn't gliding with a wind glider, it's about sending signals from the ground to airborne units — like Vesper — so we can instruct them to perform complex maneuvers and defeat monsters — represented by targets, naturally...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It should be a novel experience — a pleasant little surprise.

response.speaker: Vesper
response.text: Shrawrr!

choices.text: So we're not gliding, we're guiding?

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: That's right! This flying challenge is a technical demonstration. Our goal is to showcase the new direction we're taking to develop the Knights' reconnaissance capabilities to our colleagues.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Amber may be able to accurately detect enemy movements and make concise records while gliding... But that's not a skill that every knight can aspire to.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: The goal for Vesper and me is to write a comprehensive set of instructions so that ordinary knights can coordinate with well-trained Mondstadt falcons and form a pair of "eyes in the sky."

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: That way, even without strong Outriders, we can gather intelligence over sustained periods and ensure steady progress when advancing.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: In fact, with the innovative forward-facing weaponry that Vesper is equipped with, some of the weaker airborne monsters we encounter can be eliminated in advance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, very impressive! You sound just like an engineer!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Relax, Eija. There's no need to be so serious around these two — you're not talking to Commander Frederica.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Just think of it as playing with a new animal friend. The most important thing is to have fun!

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Sorry, Amber, I'm just really eager to get underway. Vesper and I have been training hard for this demonstration.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: If we can get your approval, Honorary Knight and the Helper in White, it'll mean our instructions are basically good to go — then we can polish them up a little and put them into practice!

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Of course, you might encounter a few... mechanical malfunctions during the demonstration. We've been training pretty intensely and may have ended up wearing out some of the components.

response.speaker: Eija
response.text: Once the replacement components are all ready, we'll swap everything out. Don't worry, we'll make sure Vesper's backpack works perfectly in the field!

response.speaker: Vesper
response.text: Shrawrr!

choices.text: I'll be strict, but I won't be harsh.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then Paimon's gonna give it a proper go too!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hehe, sounds like all four of you are bursting to go! Well then, have fun!

choices.text: Don't worry, I'm not here to nitpick.
So we just sit at the back and send signals?
I've never heard of this position...
